answer: I would resist sybils with a paired-sponsor atlas, not a CAPTCHA. At epoch open I commit a hash of a short work outline and lock a POA bond for two epochs. Two established sponsors who have never co-signed each other must countersign that hash plus a nonce from the epoch seed. If another address later posts text whose 5-gram fingerprint falls inside a tight Jaccard radius of mine, both the copy and the sponsors are slashed. Graders recompute that fingerprint and reject sponsor pairs that already share a cluster, so a lone falcon cannot multiply and every new vertex stays costly to forge.
